At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. About The Team

The Factory Platform team is building the digital backbone for all engineering, manufacturing, test, launch, and data review operations at Relativity. Each day we are getting to know our users in every department of the company, defining the core abstractions Relativity is using to scale our vehicle program. Like an operating system for manufacturing, our software enables users to understand, make decisions about, and command the factory.

Every engineer on our team owns a core part of our system. As an engineer on our team, you will be responsible for understanding your software system and the domain area so you can make informed technical decisions about how to evolve the system over time.

In an environment where everyone has access to AI, our team sees good software as a castle surrounded by a marketplace. In this metaphor, the castle represents a core database and APIs with all the domain objects and critical workflows relevant to the business. Our team builds that castle; we define the abstractions, own the database, and build the API. The village represents a large collection of user-created tools and dashboards that call our APIs. Our goal is to empower to company to build whatever they need on our platform.

We are also building the biggest, best market tent in the marketplace, applying our craft and sense of good software to build something refined that is much higher wuality than what nontechnical users can vibecode in a day

We believe in using AI to amplify an individual's own intellect and sense of design, as opposed to simply automating mediocre work. We also believe in using AI to bring order to chaotic systems, and to design software that is better and more robust than before.

If you're fired up about building the digital foundation of humanity's future in space, we are the team for you.

As a Software Engineer I on the Factory Platform team, you will build applications that directly support design and manufacturing engineers across the company. You will participate in the full software development lifecycle, from understanding user requirements to designing, implementing, testing, and deploying solutions. You'll follow agile development practices, write quality code that is continuously integrated and deployed, and iterate based on feedback from the engineers and operators who use your tools every day.

Python experience for instrument control, automated test, and data analysis.

Participate in software design reviews, code reviews, configuration management, and engineering change processes.
Create and maintain software documentation, including design specifications, interface documentation, test procedures, and technical reports.

About Summit Securities Group

Summit Securities Group is a proprietary trading firm established in 2012. Headquartered in New York City, we trade our own capital across global markets, combining experienced traders, quantitative research, and in-house technology.

The Role

We are looking for a versatile, experienced Software Engineer to join our Core Engineering team. This is an all-around role: one day you may be building production C++ services, the next writing Python tooling for researchers, and the next untangling a reference data issue across international listings. You will work across the trading stack — from the systems that power live trading to the data, tools, and pipelines that keep them accurate — while partnering directly with our quantitative researchers, traders, and operations teams.

The Team

Core Engineering builds the infrastructure used across the firm — every trading desk, research, and compliance and risk — spanning both front and back office. On our lean team, we view engineering holistically rather than functionally: you won't be restricted to a narrow component, and your work will directly impact our bottom line alongside seasoned mentors and brilliant peers.

Responsibilities

Build and Own Trading Systems: Design, develop, and maintain C++ components of our trading platform, driving projects from initial whiteboard design through deployment and production support.
Develop Python Tooling and Pipelines: Build Python services, test harnesses, and data analysis pipelines that help researchers and traders rapidly iterate on new signals and strategies.
Own Reference Data: Build and maintain the systems that source, normalize, and validate security master and reference data — symbology, corporate actions, contract specifications, trading calendars, and cross-listing mappings.
Support Global, Multi-Asset Trading: Extend our platform across equities, ETFs, ADRs, options, and futures, and across US and international venues, handling the market-specific conventions each one brings.
Operate in Production: Troubleshoot live issues across Linux systems, data feeds, and applications; improve monitoring, automation, and reliability.
Partner Across the Firm: Work side-by-side with quantitative researchers, traders, and operations, translating business needs into pragmatic engineering solutions.

The Tech Stack

We use the right tool for the job. In this role, you will heavily utilize:

Languages: Modern C++ and Python, used side by side.
Infrastructure: Linux, from development through production.

You Bring

Requirements

Experience: 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering systems end to end.
C++ and Python: Strong, production-level experience in both modern C++ and Python. We weigh these roughly equally and are looking for someone comfortable moving between them.
Linux: Solid working knowledge of Linux — shell, bash scripting, debugging, and supporting applications in production.
Onsite Collaboration: A willingness to work onsite in our office 4 days a week.

Strongly Preferred

Industry Experience: Background in finance, electronic trading, or market-making.
Reference Data: Hands-on experience with security master and reference data — symbology (tickers, ISINs, SEDOLs, FIGIs), corporate actions, contract specifications, and exchange calendars.
Non-US Markets: Exposure to international markets and their nuances, such as differing trading hours, holidays, settlement conventions, currencies, and venue rules.
Multi-Asset Knowledge: Familiarity with options, futures, ADRs, and ETFs — for example, option chains and expirations, futures rolls, ADR ratios and underlying mappings, and ETF creation/redemption and constituents.

Extras

Trading Systems: Experience with order management, execution logic, market data handlers, or venue gateways.
Performance: Exposure to latency-sensitive or high-throughput systems.
Data Engineering: Experience building ETL pipelines, data quality checks, or vendor data integrations (e.g., Bloomberg, Refinitiv, exchange feeds).
Tooling: Familiarity with the Python data stack (pandas, NumPy, Polars) and CI/CD, containers, or job scheduling.
SQL: Working proficiency writing and tuning queries against relational databases.

Versatile Generalist: You’re as comfortable in a C++ codebase as in a Python application, and you reach for whatever tool the problem needs.
Technical Curiosity & Pragmatic Ownership: You want to understand how things work under the hood, balanced with a hands-on, pragmatic approach to delivering commercial solutions.
Attention to Detail: In trading, accuracy is paramount — especially in reference data, where one bad mapping can ripple across systems. You handle edge cases carefully.
Collaborative Orientation: You are energized by working closely within a team and communicating clearly across research, trading, and operations.
Driven by Impact: You take deep satisfaction in seeing your work have a direct, measurable effect on our P&L and operations.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

As a Software Engineer, Embedded Systems / Firmware, you'll work at the intersection of software and hardware to build and maintain the low-level platform stack that powers Rivet's body-worn and field-deployed devices — including our AR/XR soldier systems, which combine real-time sensor fusion (cameras, IMUs, depth sensors) with a display and compute pipeline running on embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments. You'll focus on the kernel, BSP, HALs, drivers, and board bring-up that make that pipeline reliable, secure, performant, and power-efficient enough to run all day on a warfighter's body.

You'll work closely with hardware, electrical, and sensor-fusion/AR software engineers to integrate new hardware, debug issues across the full system stack, and deliver platform software/firmware that holds up under the SWaP, thermal, and ruggedization constraints of field-deployed defense hardware. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership over meaningful pieces of the platform.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain system-level software/firmare for power- and thermally-constrained, body-worn embedded devices across embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments, with a focus on the kernel, BSP, HALs, and device drivers.
Bring up new hardware and peripherals, working closely with electrical and hardware engineers to debug issues across the hardware/software boundary.
Debug complex issues involving hardware, kernel, drivers, boot processes, power management, memory, and system performance — with power and thermal efficiency treated as first-class constraints given our SWaP requirements.
Develop automated tests for system-level software, including hardware-in-the-loop validation.
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and platform bring-up activities.

Requirements

BS in CS/CE/EE, or equivalent industry experience.
3+ years of experience developing system-level software/firmware for embedded Linux or RTOS environments.
Experience developing embedded software/firmware for ARM-based SoCs, MPUs, or MCUs in systems with multiple interconnected processors.
Experience developing and integrating low-level device drivers, interfacing with custom hardware and peripherals, and bringing up new hardware.
Strong C/C++ programming skills and familiarity with low-level debugging and development tools such as JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.
Experience with common hardware interfaces and protocols such as USB, MIPI, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, and PCIe.
Ability to diagnose complex system-level issues using logs, traces, debuggers, and hardware instrumentation.
Familiarity with embedded software test automation and hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) or system integration testing
Comfortable working cross-functionally in a highly collaborative environment with engineers across software, electrical, mechanical, and systems disciplines.
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance, if required for the role.

Preferred Qualifications

MS in CS/CE/EE, or equivalent industry experience.
Understanding of embedded Linux/RTOS/bare boot processes, device configuration, memory management, and system initialization for embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments across SoC, MPU, and MCU platforms.
Working knowledge of trusted boot chain, secure OTA updates, system integrity, and other platform security mechanisms.
Experience with Yocto, Buildroot, Bazel, Soong, or similar embedded/system build environments.
Experience developing embedded software/firmware for resource-constrained, body-worn, or wearable devices with power, thermal, memory, or compute limitations.
Experience working on safety-critical, high-assurance, defense, aerospace, or other demanding embedded systems.
Experience with camera, display, or sensor pipelines feeding AR/XR or spatial-computing applications.
Active security clearance.

We are seeking two experienced Data Engineer Testers

The platform processes substantial volumes of structured and unstructured healthcare data, including clinical records, pathology reports, and other medical datasets.

The successful candidates will validate data ingestion, transformation, mapping accuracy, semantic alignment, and overall pipeline performance. A key component of the role will involve testing and validating outputs generated by Machine Learning models, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies to ensure data accuracy and alignment with established healthcare standards and medical ontologies.

Candidates should bring a combination of hands-on data engineering, automated testing, big data quality assurance, and healthcare or life sciences domain experience.

Data Pipeline & ETL Testing

Design, develop, and execute automated testing frameworks to validate complex ETL pipelines and large-scale data transformations.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across ingestion, processing, transformation, and output stages.
Develop SQL and Python-based scripts to perform data reconciliation, validation, and automated quality checks.
Test data processing workflows across distributed environments and large-scale platforms.
Identify, document, and troubleshoot data discrepancies, transformation defects, and pipeline failures.

AI-Driven Data Mapping & Model Validation

Develop testing strategies to validate automated data mapping and semantic alignment generated by Machine Learning models and LLMs.
Verify AI-generated mapping outputs against established healthcare data standards, medical terminologies, and biomedical ontologies.
Evaluate mapping accuracy, precision, consistency, and completeness across diverse clinical and medical datasets.
Develop test datasets and validation benchmarks to assess model performance and identify mapping errors or inconsistencies.
Collaborate with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to investigate defects and improve model validation processes.

Performance, Load & Scalability Testing

Conduct performance, stress, and load testing across high-volume data ingestion and processing pipelines.
Benchmark data throughput, processing speed, resource utilization, and system responsiveness under varying workloads.
Validate distributed data processing performance across technologies such as PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS EMR.

Identify performance bottlenecks and collaborate with engineering teams to improve processing efficiency and scalability.

Unstructured Data & NLP Validation

Validate the accuracy of extracted medical entities, terminology, relationships, and clinical information from medical records and pathology reports.
Test entity recognition, classification, normalization, and semantic extraction outputs.
Verify that extracted information is correctly mapped to standardized medical terminologies and data structures.

Regulatory Compliance & Data Quality Assurance

Validate data lineage, traceability, audit logging, and security controls throughout the data processing lifecycle.
Ensure testing practices support applicable healthcare and life sciences regulatory and privacy requirements, including HIPAA, GDPR, and relevant GxP requirements.
Verify data handling, access controls, and documentation requirements within regulated healthcare data environments.
Maintain test documentation, execution evidence, defect records, and validation results to support auditability and compliance.

Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, and automated regression suites.
Track testing progress, defects, and resolution activities using Jira or Azure DevOps.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and Business Analysts to resolve technical issues.
Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, testing reviews, defect triage, and release readiness assessments.

3–5 years of professional experience in Data Testing, Data Engineering, Big Data Quality Assurance, or Software Testing focused on data-intensive applications.
1–2+ years of experience within Healthcare, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical, or related regulated data environments.

Strong SQL and Python programming skills for data validation, reconciliation, and test automation.
Experience validating structured and unstructured datasets and identifying data quality issues.

Experience working with technical teams in Agile or enterprise software delivery environments.

Strong SQL and Python programming capabilities.
Experience with PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, and/or AWS EMR.
Understanding of distributed data processing, ETL architecture, data ingestion, and transformation workflows.

Great Expectations
dbt Testing
PyTest
Automated SQL-based validation frameworks
Git-based CI/CD testing and validation pipelines

Experience developing automated data reconciliation, regression, and quality assurance scripts.

Working knowledge of Machine Learning, LLMs, NLP, and AI-assisted data mapping.
Understanding of model output validation, semantic mapping, entity extraction, and data classification.
Familiarity with GPU/TPU-accelerated computing environments, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance testing of associated data pipelines.

Demonstrated experience architecting, designing, developing, testing, and deploying secure, scalable, and maintainable full-stack web applications, including responsive user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and database integrations.

Understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, performance optimization, error handling, and secure coding practices.

Working knowledge of GCP services, including Cloud SQL, Firestore, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Secret Manager, and Identity and Access Management (IAM).
Experience with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, application logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Understanding of cloud application scalability, reliability, availability, cost optimization, and secure deployment practices.

Knowledge of emerging AI-native software development practices and their application to rapid prototyping and production-ready application delivery.

added.description:
Who We Are About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About The Role

As an early member of the Bridge engineering team, you'll have the autonomy to work on projects that are truly global in scale and aim to give customers access to products they've never had access to. Many of the use cases that we work on today didn't exist several months ago, and that's because our team is dedicated to constant improvement for our partners and end users. Our engineers have outsized ownership over projects, so if you're looking for increased autonomy working on a completely greenfield opportunity, Bridge is the place for you.

Responsibilities

Ship software to build out our suite of API products. We're an engineering and API-first company, and you'll learn first-hand and contribute towards building highly reliable, performant, and business-critical infrastructure serving thousands of developers across the globe.
Take sole ownership of projects, oftentimes without the support of Product Management, and liaise both internally with teams like Legal and Compliance and externally with our partners and developers.
Look for constant improvements to our product offerings with the explicit goal of improving the experience for our partners and end users.
Make effective tradeoffs that consider business priorities, user experience, and a sustainable technical foundation.
Improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes for the team and our broader org.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

We're open to hiring engineers at various levels of seniority (SWE through Senior Staff), but at a minimum we're looking for somebody with 5+ years of experience.
Experience building backend systems with SQL databases. Experience with frameworks such as Rails, Django, Express, or equivalent is a bonus.
An enlarged sense of ownership and the ability to lead and influence the design and direction of our products
An ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
A growth mindset, constant curiosity, and fearlessness to dive into the unknown
An ability to write maintainable, well-tested, modular code, but also be pragmatic about moving fast
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear technical documentation

Preferred Qualifications

Past experience working on crypto or financial products a plus, and while not required, we do look for people who are very passionate about building in this space
Experience with building API products a plus, but not required
Experience working with blockchain or distributed systems a big plus

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $156,800 - $285,600. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Mettis is building an autonomous control plane for next-generation AI infrastructure, helping operators deploy AI data centers faster, increase healthy GPU capacity, improve utilization, and reduce operating costs. As a Founding Software Engineer – Distributed Systems & AI Infrastructure (Java/AWS) at Mettis, you will design, build, and operate core backend services that power our autonomous AI infrastructure platform. Company Description

See how Epsilon powers connected marketing by unlocking the full potential of data and identity.

Overview

Epsilon is building the next generation Retail Media Network (RMN) platform to power onsite advertising at scale, leveraging services from our industry-leading platform that already serves billions of offsite ads across the open web. Our vision is a unified platform for both onsite and offsite ads, delivering low-latency, high-throughput performance across the board. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Core Platform Engineering team, someone with a self-starter mindset who thrives with minimal direction, can quickly grasp business and technical goals, and takes ownership from concept through delivery. This is a high-impact role where you’ll shape the architecture, optimize performance, and ensure our systems are built for scale, reliability, and innovation. You’ll be at the forefront of building a next-generation advertising platform that combines the speed and sophistication of programmatic ad serving with the personalization and commerce power of retail media. Your work will directly shape how millions of users experience advertising across top retailers and brands.

Responsibilities

Own the features and services you build, from design through production, with the support of the broader team.
Design, implement, and maintain high-performance, low-latency services for advertising.
Collaborate with product, platform, and operations teams to integrate new capabilities into the platform.
Help optimize system performance, troubleshoot production issues, and address bottlenecks across the stack.
Contribute to frontend integrations (SPAs, dashboards, tools) when needed, ensuring smooth workflows for internal and external users.
Work with data engineering teams to integrate event tracking, analytics, and reporting pipelines.
Follow and help improve code quality, testing practices, and CI/CD automation.
Deliver enhancements that enable fast, accurate, and scalable ad delivery.
Build reliable services and interfaces that support rapid feature development.
Improve system observability, monitoring, and fault tolerance.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience).
3+ years of experience in backend and/or full stack software development.
Strong development practices, including writing and testing code, version control (Git), and automated builds.
Solid backend skills in Java, with exposure to distributed systems.
Experience with streaming or pub/sub platforms (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Pulsar).

Understanding of clean software design principles; interest in low-latency, high-throughput architectures.
